name: Zach Edey
headline: Edey is back healthy and starting every game for an unbeaten Grizzlies team, giving them efficient rebounding and rim protection in about 20 minutes a night.
good: He has started all 5 games he has played, averaging 7.0 points, 7.0 rebounds and 1.4 blocks in 20.2 minutes, while Memphis sits at 6-0.
He is shooting 57.7% from the field with a 62.1% true shooting mark, and 80% at the line.
The Grizzlies are 11.2 points better per game with him on the floor (plus 56 total), and he averages 2.0 offensive rebounds.
He only turns it over 1.0 time a night, and the model grades him a B+ (76) for elite production for his minutes.
bad: His usage rate is just 13.6%, so he is a low-volume piece, and his scoring has topped out at 13 points in a game in the recent box scores.
He has had foul trouble at times, including 5 fouls and 3 turnovers in one 21 minute game where he went 0 for 2 from the field and was minus 4.
He is not a floor spacer, with only 1 made three on the year, and his minutes are capped around 20 per game.
fans: Recent coverage about Edey is mostly about health. An AP training camp story called his left ankle the key to Memphis rebuilding, and the general manager said his rehab went exactly as the team hoped. I did not find fresh fan or beat writer reaction from the last two to three weeks that focuses on him, since most of the buzz is about the team's hot start and rookie Cam Boozer.
outlook: Expect Edey to keep a starting role with roughly 20 minutes, with his value coming from rebounds, blocks and efficient finishing as long as the ankle holds up. Memphis plays New Orleans at home on Monday night (11/3, 1:00 UTC), then hosts Indiana on 11/5.

sources.title: Zach Edey's oft-injured ankle the key to Memphis Grizzlies' latest rebuilding project (AP via ABC News)
